steps.en: A notification reaches the officer's dashboard
steps.why_id: Fitur notifikasi untuk officer tidak ada.

steps.en: Officer opens a notification to view it
steps.why_en: There is nothing on the dashboard to click.
steps.why_id: Tidak ada yang bisa diklik di dashboard.

steps.en: Officer marks the notification as read
steps.why_en: No read or unread marking exists.

steps.en: The read notification disappears from the dashboard
steps.id: Notifikasi yang dibaca hilang dari dashboard
steps.why_en: There is no notification list to clear.
steps.why_id: Tidak ada daftar notifikasi yang bisa dibersihkan.
